ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.16 is the first bounded-risk aggressive-parallel playtest. V0.4.15 already proved the scheduler can fan out across all eight configured workers on a 12-logical-processor system; V0.4.16 now feeds those workers more useful AI work. For supported Pawn traversal shapes, the main thread captures live Region.Allows decisions and the current Region graph, workers build immutable per-Pawn connectivity profiles, and validated profile predictions may bypass expensive live Reachability/RegionTraverser calls. Every new profile begins in shadow-validation mode and remains periodically sampled against Vanilla; mismatches trigger a per-profile cooldown and repeated mismatches globally fuse the module off. VFECore Phasing retains earlier-prefix authority. Worker threads still do not commit Pawn jobs, reservations or game-state mutations. V0.4.15 scheduler fan-out, the V0.4.14 persistent map fabric, V0.4.6/V0.4.7 hauling acceleration, bounded path-shadow diagnostics and Butter++ logical-tick barriers remain enabled. Performance priority: visible stutter first, bounded correctness risk second, TPS third.
